name: Menu
description: The installation's admin sidebar, set by the sysadmin in Platform -> Menu instead of config/menu.ts: workspaces, groups, items and custom links per role and custom group, every label a translation key (English in the menu, other languages in the translation module's table), draft, preview, publish, revisions, export and import. One menu per installation (docs/phases/54-menu-editor).
author: Kuray Karaaslan

permissions.name: Read the installation's menu
permissions.description: System-level: open Platform -> Menu, read the published menu, the draft, the history and the catalog. Root super-admin only (GLOBAL scope).

permissions.name: Edit the installation's menu
permissions.description: System-level: edit the draft, publish, restore and import the sidebar every tenant sees. Root super-admin only (GLOBAL scope); audited.

extensionPoints.description: A kind of custom menu link a module offers (the dashboard's 'board'): the sysadmin picks a target of that kind in Platform -> Menu and, at each admin page load, the contributor turns it into a tenant-relative /admin path the viewer may open in their tenant, or into nothing. Default export: LinkTargetProvider { kind, label, suggest(q), validate(target), resolve(viewer, targets) }; kind must not be 'page' or 'url'. The resolved page's guard still applies. A contributor that fails hides only its own links. shell_menu imports nothing of the contributing module.

metadata.label: The labels of the installation's menu

extensions.description: Phase 55: the signal kinds this module emits (the audit actions it owns: the platform menu's draft discarded, published, a revision restored, a menu file imported), each attribute with its personal-data class. Read by ai_firewall through its registry; imports only the contract from common.

metadata.label: shell_menu: the platform menu published, restored, imported and its draft discarded (phase 55 coverage)
